items.title: Nvidia picks Unitree for humanoid robot platform as Chinese startup eyes IPO
items.titleCn: Nvidia picks Unitree for humanoid robot platform as Chinese startup eyes IPO
items.summary: Nvidia has selected Chinese humanoid robot maker Unitree for the first robotics system the U.S. chipmaker is selling to researchers from Stanford to ETH Zurich, the company announced Monday.
